name: corrections editor
normative-structure: Whether a published Koios.News error is corrected — the correction transaction run, the affected article's claim ledger updated, and a correction notice attached — is this office's own answer. It reports to the standards editor and never to the editor-in-chief, so a desk's editorial interest can never suppress or delay a correction.
theory-basis: News Property Specification §6, engineering-services-section/services/media-engineering-services-section/services/news-media-engineering-services-section/content/text/documents/articles/specifications/2026-09-02-news-property-specification.md — a corrections editor office owns the correction transaction and does not route through the top editor

The Distal Bypass, operations-services-section/content/text/documents/articles/notes/2026/07/16/2026-07-16-the-distal-bypass.md — every erasure is priced; the corrections editor's immunity against editor-in-chief override is how that pricing stays real rather than discretionary
